title: Invasion of Turkey
description: Attack north from Syria and Iraq through Anatolia, supported by eastern Mediterranean carriers. Take all 59 cities, including Istanbul and the navigable straits.
implementationNotes: Registered as invasion-turkey in E.scenarios.byId; GSHHS sampled with explicit navigable Bosporus and Dardanelles. Standalone and Britannian Tier 4 Campaign mission; no turn limit; ports are capturable and AI uses europe doctrine. Do not merge without approval.
